svg.title: The Cordaro family's two crossings from Sicily to Pennsylvania
svg.desc: Antonio's April 1906 crossing is reported in his naturalization papers, but the passenger match is unresolved. Pietra Magro and daughters Calogera and Maria appear on the Calabria passenger list, sailing Palermo to New York in August and September 1909 and naming Antonio in Pittsburgh.

g.text: A family crossed the Atlantic in stages
Antonio's voyage comes from his later account. Pietra and their daughters have a matching 1909 passenger list.
A similar Weimar record differs on departure port and arrival day; it is still a candidate.
1909 · Pietra Magro + Calogera, 9, + Maria, 4 · passenger list
Mother Carmela Di Prima in Sutera
The family later lived in West Wyoming; this manifest does not date that move.
Sources: Antonio's 1927 petition; Calabria manifest; Joseph's 1940 card. Routes show ports and reported destinations, not sea tracks.
